notes.title: Update 0.85b: Buyable Defenses, Readable Docs & UI Updates
notes.notes:
[b]Survivor, ready for Beta 0.85b?[/b]  
Dive into our biggest rewrite yet - focused on gear, enemies, UI, and network performance!
In short, yes we are close to the public early access version, yes we try to add at the moment a Workshop support (looks good at the moment🤐) and yes, there are a plenty of new cool things you can try here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/b4bbcfe318feb1f34aebad98ba51e505a343521c.png[/img]

[h3]New Equipment System[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Loadout Rework:[/b] Choose your Primary Weapon, Grenade Type, Special Equipment, and Vest based on player level.  
[*] [b]Primary Weapons:[/b] Brand-new pistols, rifles, and shotguns - each with unique stats and perks.  
[*] [b]Grenade Types:[/b] Molotov, Fragmentation, Stun, and Decoy grenades for damage or tactical diversion.  
[*] [b]Special Equipment:[/b] Deploy mobile barricades, automated turrets, ammo crates, and med-kits on demand.  
[*] [b]Vests:[/b] Level-based armor perks: damage reduction, extra ammo, and faster revives.  
[/list]

[h3]UI & UX Improvements[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Redesigned Loadout menu in the Main Menu for instant customization.  
[*] Streamlined Pause & Options menus with clearer navigation and visuals.  
[*] Readable in-game documents and a dedicated News Hub in multiplayer.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/367494f57737cc0b23a5d0fad62c670e12beb1a4.png[/img]

[h3]New Gameplay Elements[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Enemy Variety:[/b] Face Sprinters, Tanks, Toxic mutants, and deadly Huggers that latch onto you!  
[*] [b]Upgradeable Weapons:[/b] Use Upgrade Stations (Tier 1 → 2 → 3) to boost ammo capacity and damage.  
[*] [b]Supply Machines:[/b] Spend earned coins to deploy barricades, defensive turrets, and gear as rounds progress.
[*] [b]Bots:[/b] Just need some help while exploring the endless survival mode? Add up to 4 Bots to your lobby which can replaced by real players if other players joining your server - and don't worry, they will be back, if someone leaves your match!
[/list]

[h3]Network & Performance[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Anti-lag improvements keep movement, shooting, and aiming smooth even under high ping.  
[*] Optimized replication for weapons and interactions delivers a more stable multiplayer experience.  
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Polish[/h3]  
We’ve squashed countless bugs for seamless beta testing:  
- 🥲 Retained weapons after round restarts  
- 🤔 Fixed animation, audio, and UI glitches  
- 🔥 Resolved spawn, collision, and revive issues  
- 😎 Polished sprint, interaction cancel, and round-logic mechanics  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/e4e38b2e4f95194622a863e9f3dd8e2991bc55b6.png[/img]

[h3]Timeline & Progress[/h3]
As you may have noticed, Battle of Decay: Survival has slipped a bit from our original roadmap - but rest assured we’re still targeting a full release in 2025. Life’s unexpected turns (personal commitments, contract work) combined with the need to squash critical bugs and layer in brand-new features have stretched our schedule.

We firmly believe in shipping a product we’re proud of - one that never feels “half-done". Every new system, level or polish pass makes BoD:S richer and more immersive, even if it means extra development time and cost.

The good news? Early Access is closer than ever. With our core features locked in and under rigorous testing, we’re on track to welcome you into the world of Battle of Decay: Survival before the end of 2025. Stay tuned - and thank you for your patience and support! 🙂 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/539ee27665ed2723220cdc4924e356a6d04cccc0.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.23: Battle of Decay: Survival evolves
notes.notes:
[b]Survivors, the wait is over ![/b]
We're ecstatic to roll out Update 0.23 for Battle of Decay: Survival. This isn't just any update; it's a game-changer. Here's what's new.

[list]
[*] [b]Realism Boosted:[/b] We've added more background assets to make your environment feel even more lifelike.
[*] [b]Effects Galore:[/b] New grenade explosion effects, visual impact effects, and improved bullet effects will make every battle more intense and immersive.
[*] [b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b] From the addition of an audio announcer and LAN mode for servers to an improved saving system and HUD, we've taken gameplay to the next level.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've squashed a multitude of bugs, from animation glitches to AI spawning issues in the Bunker level. Your gameplay should now be smoother than ever.
[*] [b]Improvements All Around:[/b] Whether it's the UI, overall graphical quality, or the 'Bunker' level design, we've made enhancements across the board.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/fb2d65eab7916bfdda4397f78bb3750a71defe84.png[/img]
It's time to talk about the early access phase where people can finally play this game. We will engage the early access phase as soon as possible, but first there are some feature and maps to implement. For example I wanna have at least 4 levels ready (with sublevels), before I talk about the 'ea'.

[h3]What we need for enter 'early access'[/h3]
Before entering 'early access', we aim to complete 4 main levels for a comprehensive testing experience. Each main level, like the Level 1 (Hospital), is divided into 3 sublevels, ensuring a gameplay duration of roughly 30 minutes per level. Thus, in the early access phase, players can expect to invest 30 minutes for each main level. While Battle of Decay: Survival is designed for quick fun, it's meant to be more than just a 5-minute distraction.

[h3]Our Progress so far[/h3]
At present, our focus is on refining story elements, particularly animations. We've largely completed the Hospital Levels (Level 1), and Level 2 is about 70% finished. Overall, we're roughly at the 65% completion mark. However, this doesn't mean we're taking it easy. There's still a significant amount of work ahead. Your feedback is invaluable to us, ensuring we make the best first impression and incorporate the most desired features before launching into early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/4f08550a4c4f9b099dc525d13e8faf73b5a5570b.png[/img]
In the upcoming update multiple features will be added. We just need time to implement these features and them. Molotov Cocktails? Yea, sounds great, but what's about enemies and gameplay features?

[h3]Better Communication through text and voice chat[/h3]

We plan to add a ping system for better communication in mulitplayer and additionally a compact chat system for players who don't wanna or just can't communicate via voice chat. Another construction side is the front steam shop page, which is not done yet. 

[h3]Hey, what are these creatures over there?[/h3]

But when we talk about Battle of Decay: Survival, there are more important feature which will be added in the next updates. More enemies. This is a very important change to the current game and will enhance the gameplay but also increase the difficulty of the game. The default enemies are sometimes slow and sometimes faster, but with future updates, we will add more kinds of enemies who will hunt you. 

[b]You or them, easy right?[/b] Let's see ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42920864/539ee27665ed2723220cdc4924e356a6d04cccc0.png[/img]
